question: Which region has become the new epicenter of global terrorism, according to the GTI (Global Terrorism Index) 2024?

options.text: Central Sahel region of sub-Saharan Africa

solution:
The correct answer is __**Central Sahel region of sub-Saharan Africa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Central Sahel region** of sub-Saharan Africa has been identified as the new epicenter of global terrorism, according to the **Global Terrorism Index (GTI) 2024**.
 
• This region includes countries such as **Mali, Burkina Faso, and Niger**, which are experiencing a significant rise in terrorist activity.
 
• Jihadist groups such as **Islamic State (IS) affiliates** and al-Qaeda-linked groups are active in this area, causing instability and violence.
 
• Factors contributing to terrorism in the Central Sahel include **weak governance, poverty, ethnic tensions, and competition over natural resources**.
 
• The number of deaths caused by terrorism in this region has surpassed those in the Middle East and North Africa, highlighting its growing significance in global security dynamics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Global Terrorism Index (GTI):**

 
 
• The GTI is an annual report published by the Institute for Economics and Peace (IEP) that measures the impact of terrorism worldwide.
 
• It uses metrics such as the number of incidents, fatalities, injuries, and property damage to rank countries and regions.
 
 
 
• **Key Terrorist Groups in the Sahel:**
 
 
• **Jama’at Nasr al-Islam wal Muslimin (JNIM):** An al-Qaeda-affiliated group active in the Sahel.
 
• **Islamic State in the Greater Sahara (ISGS):** An affiliate of ISIS causing significant instability in the region.
 
 
 
• **Drivers of Terrorism in the Sahel:**
 
 
• Political instability and lack of governance in countries like Mali and Burkina Faso.
 
• Socioeconomic challenges such as poverty and unemployment.
 
• Competition for scarce resources like water and arable land.
 
 
 
• **Regional and International Responses:**
 
 
• Efforts such as the **G5 Sahel joint force**, a regional security initiative, aim to combat terrorism.
 
• International support from organizations like the United Nations and countries like France is critical for counter-terrorism operations.
